dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What kind of posts are on there?

dialogues.speaker: Cherkassky
dialogues.text: A little bit of everything. Strange things people have noticed lately, interesting stories, questions they want answered... Some people are looking for friends with the same hobbies, and others are trying to track down lost items.

dialogues.speaker: Cherkassky
dialogues.text: The board gets plenty of new posts every day. People seem to like having a place to talk like this.

dialogues.speaker: Cherkassky
dialogues.text: But! There's one rule I always follow with the message board — well, my own rule, anyway.

dialogues.speaker: Cherkassky
dialogues.text: Never, ever meet up with someone too soon after only exchanging a few posts.

dialogues.speaker: Cherkassky
dialogues.text: If it doesn't go well, you may not gain a new friend, and you might lose a perfectly good message-board friend, too...
